scope: Partial CPU replay of both preregistered planar profiles. Laplace and remaining scientific arms are outside this evidence record.

existing_readout.diagnosis: The full-line fit mixes the falling interior transition with the rising interface across the periodic seam; these transitions have opposite slopes.

interface_diagnostic.method: Perform separate ordinary least-squares fits to atanh(1-2*phi) = slope*y + intercept over 0.05 < phi < 0.95 using final profile_line. W = 2/abs(slope); max_dev is the maximum |phi - (0.5-0.5*tanh(slope*y+intercept))| of these samples. Periodic samples use profile_line[y % 64].
interface_diagnostic.use: Post-run diagnosis of the measurement. This separate fit is not a replacement gate or scientific acceptance.

laplace_readout_review: The R=12, W=4 preregistered inner shell spans r/R = 0.95..1.05. At initialization the tanh profile has |phi-0.5| <= 0.14566 in that shell, while the preregistration describes skipping |phi-0.5| < 0.45. The implemented pressure sampler averages the radial shell without the stated phase mask. Resolve the measurement contract before accepting a Laplace verdict.
